reportModal.title: Report {{targetType}}
reportModal.disclaimer: Reporting is a serious action reviewed by staff. Please only report content that genuinely violates our community guidelines — unjustified or repeated misuse of reporting can lead to restrictions on your own account.

warnAndRemoveModal.title: Warn & Remove {{targetType}}
warnAndRemoveModal.description: This immediately masks {{username}}'s {{targetType}} and issues them a warning, skipping the report queue. Any other pending reports on this exact item are closed automatically.
warnAndRemoveModal.reasonPlaceholder: Explain what's wrong with this content or profile field
warnAndRemoveModal.successMessage: The content has been masked and the author warned.
adminActionsPanel.title: Admin actions
adminActionsPanel.description: Staff-only account actions, independent of the report queue.
banButton.label: Ban user
banModal.title: Ban user
banModal.description: This marks the account as banned, independent of any report or warning history. All of the user's content will be automatically moderated (hidden from other users), the same as when a report against it is accepted — the account itself stays fully usable. There is currently no way to un-ban a user, so make sure this is warranted.
banModal.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this account is being banned
banModal.successMessage: The account has been banned. All of the user's content is now automatically moderated.
